confidence_notes: Restaurant anchors use current Hiroshima city-level price data. The cocktail estimate uses the low end of a local proper-bar range; the wine glass is inferred at about 1.4 times draft beer because comparable by-the-glass data was sparse. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates without live booking checks.
comparable_city_reasoning: Restaurant anchors are Hiroshima-specific. For lodging, I used a regional Japanese tourism-city basis similar to Fukuoka, without a Tokyo or Kyoto peak-market premium.
